selection: All full-box six-band catalog acquisitions in the fixed interval; alternate versions deduplicated by acquisition time using scene-cloud/date/ID order, never observed NDVI. Fail if the fixed acquisition budget is exceeded.
interpretation: Exploratory follow-up after inspecting the original case, not blinded validation. Reuse original earlier-year references only within their May 21–June 5 calendar window; other dates are absolute observations only.
limitations: One locality proxy, not confirmed farm boundaries, crop identity or crop stage
Seven-day freshness is an unvalidated research policy, not an operational service guarantee
No interpolation or treating cloud gaps and absent reports as healthy crops
Original four-year reference is not climatology or verified unaffected controls
No independent field labels, trained model, causal attribution or historical delivery claim
